name: Mallet
description: A shared puck stays in the arena while Mallet fights. Both fighters can strike and return it. Every 4 seconds, Mallet charges its next puck contact into a faster, harder shot. One damage hit per strike; no homing. A return shot can hit Mallet.
author: Ball Arena contributors
